therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: B-cell depletion through anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody binding
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Reduction of autoimmune B-cell mediated neuroinflammation in opsoclonus-myoclonus syndrome
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Feasibility of using 4 weekly Rituximab infusions and toxicity assessment

results.target_engagement_evidence: 0/4 participants showed B cell depletion based on serum IgG levels
biomarker_changes: No B cell depletion observed based on serum IgG levels
safety_signals: Febrile illness with upper respiratory symptoms and dehydration in 1/4 participants
No grade 3 or 4 toxicity that failed to resolve
results.dose_information: 375 mg/m2 IV on days 1, 8, 15, and 22 with dose escalation protocol from 0.5 mg/kg/hour to maximum 400 mg/hour

context.duration: Treatment over 4 weeks with follow-up to day 270 for adverse events
context.investigator_commentary: Trial closed early due to low accrual and did not enroll adequate numbers to conduct detailed statistical analysis
